Memberships · October 10, 2026 · 3 min read

How Much Is a Gym Membership in Vineland, NJ?

By the Animal Paradise coaching team · Vineland, NJ

Short answer: At Animal Paradise in Vineland, memberships run from $60 to $80 a month. The 12-month Gold plan is $60, the no-contract Silver plan is $70, and a day pass is $20. What you pay depends mostly on two choices: contract length and which extras you want included.

Contract vs no contract

Gyms usually charge less per month when you commit for a year. At Animal Paradise the gap is $10 a month: Silver is $70 with no contract and Gold is $60 on a 12-month agreement. If you already know you will train for the next year, the 12-month plan saves $120. If you are not sure yet, no contract is the safer start.

What each Animal Paradise plan costs

PlanPriceTermAdds
Silver$70/moNo contractFull gym, sauna rooms, posing room, 4 studio classes
Gold$60/mo12 monthsEverything in Silver, daycare add-on, 5% off cafe and supps
Premium$70/mo12 monthsHibernation Station recovery room, towel service, 10% off
Platinum$70/mo12 months, womenLioness Den, towel service, 10% off
Diamond$80/mo12 months, womenLioness Den and Hibernation Station, daycare, 10% off

Passes if you are not ready to join

A day pass is $20 and a one-week pass is $40. Both are good for visitors, people in town for work, or anyone who wants a full week to test the gym before deciding.

Add-ons that change the real cost

  • Daycare: $9.99 a month on eligible plans
  • Towel service: $10 a month if your plan does not include it
  • Classes: $15 each beyond the ones included
  • Fit3D body scan: $20

How to pick the cheapest plan for you

Count what you would use every week. If you want the recovery room, Premium at $70 costs less than Gold plus paying for recovery elsewhere. If you are a woman who wants a private training space, Platinum gives you the Lioness Den for the same $70. Use the membership finder to match a plan in three questions.

Quick answers

How much is a gym membership at Animal Paradise?

Plans run from $60 to $80 a month. Gold is $60 on 12 months and Silver is $70 with no contract.

Does Animal Paradise have a day pass?

Yes. A day pass is $20 and a one-week pass is $40.
